description: Replace the owned quote's quantity, material, production speed, or fulfillment and recalculate pricing. This overwrites the current quote configuration and invalidates its prior price approval. Any still-open checkout session for the quote or its linked build is expired; the old checkout link cannot be restored. Tell the customer that an existing unpaid checkout link will stop working before applying their requested changes. Show the revised quote and obtain renewed approval before creating a new unpaid checkout link. Paid quotes and active payment authorizations cannot be changed. This tool does not charge, capture, refund, or release manufacturing.

accessToken.description: Guest token returned by printing.sessions.start. Optional when Authorization already carries a permanent key or guest token.

fulfillmentMethod.description: How the completed parts should be delivered.

materialId.description: AIURION material identifier listed by printing.capabilities.get. Send this when creating a quote; omission defaults to black_pla. A material change re-slices the model and invalidates the prior price approval.

productionSpeed.description: Requested production priority: standard or rush.

quantity.description: Updated number of identical parts, from 1 to 150.

quoteId.description: AIURION quote UUID returned by printing.quotes.create.
